preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 10**6 for S in S_list)
preconditions.description: Length of each binary string S is between 1 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in S) for S in S_list)
preconditions.description: Each character in the binary string S is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in the output matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, int) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each line in the output is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result <= len(S) for result, S in zip(output, S_list))
postconditions.description: Each result is a non-negative integer not greater than the length of the corresponding binary string S.
